sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 協作機器人應用驗證
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：時間帳可重現，單物體模型限制突出，沒有把0.070 m當現場安全認證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The timing ledger reproduces, its single-object limits are prominent, and 0.070 m is not called safety certification.
related.difference: 區分等效質量、速度、接觸力及壓力，建立完整應用驗證的缺口表。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish effective mass, speed, contact force and pressure, building an application-validation gap list.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 單一物體的簡化行進量d=vT+dstop+u；不包含人員接近速度、全身幾何或功能安全失效率。 離線合成v=0.2 m/s、總延遲T=0.10 s、已量得停止行程0.03 m、比較餘量0.02 m。 d=0.2×0.10+0.03+0.02=0.070 m。此值只能驗證課內時間帳。
平動近似E=mv²/2；相同能量可因接觸面積、剛性與受夾困條件產生不同後果。 純教學等效質量2 kg，速度0.20 m/s；不代表人體傷害或協作機器人允許值。 E=0.5×2×0.20²=0.040 J；只代表此模型瞬間動能。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A single-object teaching sumd=vT+dstop+u excludes human approach, body geometry and functional-safety failure rates. Offline syntheticv 0.2 m/s, total latency 0.10 s, measured stopping travel 0.03 m and comparison allowance 0.02 m. d=0.070 m; this value verifies only the classroom time ledger.

TranslationalE=mv²/2 is only an approximation; equal energy can have different consequences with area, stiffness and trapping. Teaching effective mass 2 kg and speed 0.20 m/s; not injury thresholds or permissible collaborative-robot values. E=0.040 J, only the instantaneous kinetic energy of this model.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 雷射追蹤儀大尺寸量測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：時間帳可重現，單物體模型限制突出，沒有把0.070 m當現場安全認證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The timing ledger reproduces, its single-object limits are prominent, and 0.070 m is not called safety certification.
related.difference: 把角度誤差換成橫向位置誤差，建立測站配置的量化比較。
related.differenceEn: Convert angular error into transverse position error for quantitative station-layout comparison.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 單一物體的簡化行進量d=vT+dstop+u；不包含人員接近速度、全身幾何或功能安全失效率。 離線合成v=0.2 m/s、總延遲T=0.10 s、已量得停止行程0.03 m、比較餘量0.02 m。 d=0.2×0.10+0.03+0.02=0.070 m。此值只能驗證課內時間帳。
小角度下u_trans≈R uθ，與獨立徑向u_r合成u=√(u_r²+u_trans²)；真實三維協方差另處理。 合成距離R=10 m、角度標準不確定度10 μrad、徑向0.03 mm。 橫向u=10×10^−5 m=0.10 mm；合成√(0.03²+0.10²)=0.104403 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A single-object teaching sumd=vT+dstop+u excludes human approach, body geometry and functional-safety failure rates. Offline syntheticv 0.2 m/s, total latency 0.10 s, measured stopping travel 0.03 m and comparison allowance 0.02 m. d=0.070 m; this value verifies only the classroom time ledger.

For small angles, u_trans≈R u θ; combine independent radialu_r by RSS, with full 3D covariance separate. Synthetic range 10 m, angular uncertainty 10 μ rad, radial uncertainty 0.03 mm. Transverseu=0.10 mm; combinedu=0.104403 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
